title: Lake County Commission, District 2
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Only the incumbent's candidacy was confirmed in snippets (Yahoo/Daily Commercial preview). Whether he faces a November opponent could not be verified; check https://www.lakevotes.gov/190/Current-County-Candidates-Committees.

candidates.name: Sean M. Parks
candidates.occupation: Lake County commissioner since 2010; certified planner with environmental-science and engineering-management degrees
candidates.background: Sitting District 2 county commissioner and board vice-chairman; qualified Republican candidate in 2026.

taxes.summary: Says Lake County's property-tax rate is the lowest in the region and he intends to keep it that way.
taxes.quote: Lake County's property tax rate is the lowest in the region, and I intend to keep it that way.
